      'verdict': 'pass', 'defect_categories': [], 'correction': ''
    },
    {
      'requirement_id': 'accumulated-bound',
      'requirement': 'Establish the gamma(depth+1,u) componentwise perturbation bound.',
      'evidence': 'The final target explicitly asserts IsPerturbation(gamma(d+1,u),exactProductTree(T),P), with d = depth(T), gamma(k,u) = ku/(1-ku), and leaf condition |y-x| <= gamma(d+1,u)|x|. Depth is zero at a leaf and one plus the maximum child depth at a node, so d+1 accounts for one multiplication and at most d additions. Its hypothesis (d+1)u < 1 gives the required positive denominator.',
      'verdict': 'pass', 'defect_categories': [], 'correction': ''
    },
    {
      'requirement_id': 'assumption-integrity',
      'requirement': 'Use only the stated model and smallness assumptions without assuming or restricting the conclusion.',
      'evidence': 'The model assumes only u >= 0 and, for every real z, existence of delta with |delta| <= u and M.round(z) = z(1+delta). The theorem universally quantifies M and T, with sole additional hypothesis (depth(T)+1)M.u < 1. No exact-arithmetic restriction, assumed perturbation conclusion, balance condition, or bound on inputs is imposed.',
      'verdict': 'pass', 'defect_categories': [], 'correction': ''
    }
  ],
  'assumptions_added': [],
  'missing_obligations': [],
  'limitations': []
}

    json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

    f.flush()
    os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.replace(temporary, '/output/roundtrip.json')
